column1: to create new industry benchmarks for the health and safety of our employees.
Leaders in our facilities set the example for the highest safety standards.
From coaching and ergonomic training to ensuring processes and
equipment in work areas are safely operated, leaders proactively verify
and validate that safety protocols are followed. The industry-leading
safety technology we use every day is designed to protect and promote
our employees’ health, and we consistently test and refine processes to
improve working conditions in our facilities.
Above all, safety at Amazon is about our people and partners. In
2019, we provided more than one million hours of safety training
to employees. To make it all happen, we employ one of the largest
health and safety organizations on the planet, with approximately
5,000 people worldwide focused on safety. Safety, however, is the
responsibility of each and every person working at Amazon. In
Amazon’s dynamic, positive safety culture, every team is engaged and
encouraged to look out for one another.
